home.title: Your USDT. Your keys.
home.body: A USDT wallet on TRON that lives only on your device. No account, no sign-up.

send.title: Check twice. Send once.
send.body: Review the address, the amount and the TRX network fee before anything leaves your wallet.

receive.title: Get paid with a QR code
receive.body: Share your TRON address or ask for an exact amount. Receiving is free.

activity.title: See where your money goes
activity.body: Charts, insights and top counterparties, worked out on your device from your own history.

coin.title: USDT and TRX, side by side
coin.body: Prices, charts and your position for each coin you hold.

transfer.title: Every transfer, on the record
transfer.body: Status, network fee and transaction ID, with a direct link to Tronscan.

security.title: Locked with Face ID
security.body: A PIN and Face ID guard the app. Your recovery phrase stays in this device's Keychain.

widget.title: Your balance, one glance away
widget.body: Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets show your USDT without opening the app.

welcome.title: Twelve words. One PIN. Done.
welcome.body: Create a wallet or restore one with your recovery phrase. Nobody else can move your money.
